name: H5 Phoenix

profile.reading: This H5 Data Centers facility is located at 2600 West Germann Road, Chandler, Arizona 85286, in the Phoenix metro area. The operator own facility page describes a 180,000 square foot purpose built colocation building with 26 MW of capacity and up to 20 watts per cabinet density, N+1 UPS power, 48 hour diesel runtime generator backup, and N+1 cooling. The page states SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance and a 100 percent uptime track record since construction.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] This row was previously exhausted with no sourcing on file, filed under the operator field H5 rather than H5 Data Centers, the same naming inconsistency this session already handled for Data4 and Data4 Italia and for several other operators, confirmed as the same company by the shared h5datacenters.com domain already on file for this row. Fetched the operator own facility page at h5datacenters.com/phoenix-data-center.html this session, which published a full street address, square footage, and a specific 26 MW capacity figure, recorded here as this building own capacity. research_status upgraded to complete.
